description: This file contains unit tests for the ControlFilter class in the org.apache.ofbiz.webapp.control package. It tests various behaviors of the filter such as allowed paths, redirection, error code handling, and recursive redirection logic.

classes.name: ControlFilterTests
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ControlFilter servlet filter, testing various scenarios and behaviors related to request filtering and redirection.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocks and sets up the test environment before each test case.

methods.name: filterWithExactAllowedPath
methods.description: Tests that requests with exact allowed paths bypass redirection and proceed in the filter chain.

methods.name: filterWithAllowedSubPath
methods.description: Tests that requests with allowed sub-paths are permitted and do not trigger redirection.

methods.name: filterWithRedirection
methods.description: Tests that requests to disallowed paths trigger a redirection to the configured redirect path.

methods.name: filterWithURIredirection
methods.description: Verifies redirection to a full URI when configured, for disallowed requests.

methods.name: bailsOutWithVariousErrorCodes
methods.description: Tests default and specified error code responses when access is denied.

methods.name: redirectAllAllowed
methods.description: Test that with force-redirect enabled, matching allowed path triggers redirection.

methods.name: redirectAllNotAllowed
methods.description: Test that with force-redirect enabled, non-allowed path triggers redirection.

methods.name: redirectAllRecursive
methods.description: Ensures recursive redirection logic works correctly, with session attribute management to prevent looping.
